item.text:
Implemented `reserveInventory` in `src/reserve.ts`.

- Allocates up to nonnegative available stock.
- Ignores nonpositive requests.
- Reports unknown SKUs as zero allocated.
- Preserves both input objects.
- Returns updated stock in `remaining`.
- Verified behavior with Node and passed `git diff --check`.

No dependencies or unrelated changes added. TypeScript compiler wasn’t installed locally.
